notes: Skills are instants that ride on a matching action card (A/B/M/P). Per peer.mjs ridesFor(): M- and P-skills also ride on Empty Move / Empty Posture. Non-permanent skills obey Rule 8 (pc override): a skill that gave no benefit returns to the hand (rule_8_instant_returns, read off `outcome.{took_with,took_without,dealt_with,dealt_without}`). Permanent skills (is_permanent) land in the permanents holding when their action_type is played, are placed with a point-buy die of data.point_buy_stat (power for Rule 24) and may be destroyed by a Rule 24 die >= that power. Assumed battle-context fields beyond the README shape: caster.perm_power.<skill_id> (the permanent's die), caster.trance_options ([code, code]), cast.counter_element (the element Counter Spell emits), outcome.* (round maths with/without the instant), outcome.combat_damage_taken.

skill_powerful_attack.description: Instant riding on an Attack card. If the Attack lands (resolution-matrix damage >= 1 against the defender) it deals +1 damage; a blocked or neutralised Attack gains nothing. Paper lock implemented (user ruling 2026-11-16): once it paid off (its card did not return to hand under Rule 8) the caster cannot perform any other action except Attack until the end of the round — any other action it plans is played as a bare Empty Posture (no card, no skill, no cast). game/skills.mjs plan_lock; applied at planning by peer.mjs. No-benefit casts return to hand under Rule 8 (pc override) and lock nothing.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is an Attack card.
The right-clicked target is an enemy in contact (distance <= 1).

effects.description: +1 damage when the Attack's matrix damage against the defender is at least 1, else 0.
Matrix damage of the Attack plus the Powerful Attack bonus.
1 when the rest of the round is locked to Attack: the Attack landed (matrix damage >= 1), so the card stays played; any other planned action becomes a bare Empty Posture.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.

validation.description: point_buy_stat is null, 'any' or one of the four stats.

skill_overrun.description: Instant riding on an Attack card against an enemy in contact. The target's Move this round is negated (they stay on their tile) and — paper swap implemented (user ruling 2026-11-16) — when the Attack targets that adjacent enemy the attacker and the enemy swap places (walk over them and go behind): each takes the other's hex after the moves, if neither moved otherwise this action; one swap per unit and action (actor order). The Alt (push one tile away) is still not implemented. Judged by whether it did its job (negated a Move or swapped); with nothing to do it returns to hand.

The target is an enemy in contact.

effects.description: True when the target's Move / Empty Move is cancelled this round (target in contact and playing M or EM).
1 when the attacker and the adjacent enemy target trade hexes this action.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.

skill_grapple.description: Instant riding on an Attack card against an enemy in contact. A target that declared Posture has it replaced by Empty Posture (their non-instant cast is interrupted; Empty Move stays possible). The paper 'while sharing a tile neither may Posture' clause is not implemented. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when the target was not Posturing.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is an Attack card.
The target is an enemy in contact.

effects.description: The target's action after the grapple: Posture becomes Empty Posture, anything else is unchanged.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.

validation.description: point_buy_stat is null, 'any' or one of the four stats.

skill_ranged_weapon.description: Permanent skill played with an Attack card; lands in the permanents holding with a point-buy die of Matter (dice_count(matter) d6, highest die = power). While held (user rulings 2026-11-16): +1 range — the holder's Attack is opposed to an enemy's action from 2 hexes away (skills.mjs attack_range); at that range the enemy's Block deals the holder no combat damage and a Move or Posture with no contact does nothing. Against an ADJACENT enemy it gives no bonus: the Attack resolves as a plain Attack and a Block deals its regular 1 damage. The holder's Attack ignores traps and the follow rule (Rule 15). Destroyable under Rule 24 by a die >= its power. Not playable while already held.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is an Attack card.
The permanent is not already in the caster's holding.

effects.description: Number of d6 the placement point-buy rolls against Matter.
Hexes the holder's strike reaches: 2 for an Attack (+1 range), 1 for anything else.
Damage the holder does NOT take from a blocking defender: 1 when the holder Attacks into a Block from beyond contact (distance 2), else 0 (an adjacent Block hurts as usual).
A Rule 24 point-buy die destroys the permanent when it reaches the placement power.

validation.description: A permanent needs a point-buy stat: 'any' or one of the four stats.

skill_taunt.description: Permanent skill played with a Block card; placed with a point-buy die of Vitality. While held (user ruling 2026-11-16): ALL nearby enemies (in contact with the taunter) cannot Attack anything besides the taunter — their Attack on anyone else deals 0, so every ally next to the taunter is protected — and cannot use Block against the taunter: their Block deals the taunter no damage and the taunter's Attack lands on them as against an Empty action (1). Weak alone, strong in a team. Destroyable under Rule 24 by a die >= its power.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is a Block card.
The permanent is not already in the caster's holding.

effects.description: Number of d6 the placement point-buy rolls against Vitality.
Damage an enemy in contact with the taunter deals to a third unit with Attack: always 0 (null when the taunt does not apply).

Damage a nearby enemy's Block deals the taunter: always 0 (null when the taunt does not apply). The taunter's Attack on that blocker deals the matrix damage against an Empty action instead of against a Block.
A Rule 24 point-buy die destroys the permanent when it reaches the placement power.

validation.description: A permanent needs a point-buy stat: 'any' or one of the four stats.

skill_force_shield.description: Permanent skill played with a Block card; always power 6 (user ruling 2026-11-16, agent interpretation: no point-buy roll — it lands with power 6). While held: the first effect-damage leg that would land on the holder has 6 subtracted from its stat sum BEFORE the /10 rounding (Σ16 → 10 → 1); the shield is then spent (removed from the holding) whether or not damage remained. Also destroyable under Rule 24 like any power-6 permanent (Vitality).

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is a Block card.
The permanent is not already in the caster's holding.

effects.description: The landing power: always 6 (no roll; data.fixed_power).
Rule 21 damage of a cast (defender = the enemy caster, caster = the holder) after the shield's 6 is taken off the UNROUNDED summed stat delta, then /10 rounded half up.
The shield is consumed when the incoming leg would have landed without it (Rule 21 damage before the shield >= 1).
A Rule 24 point-buy die destroys the permanent when it reaches the placement power.

validation.description: A permanent needs a point-buy stat: 'any' or one of the four stats.

skill_barricade.description: Permanent skill played with a Block card; placed with a point-buy die of Vitality. While held: combat damage from an enemy's Attack or Block against the holder is 0 (effect damage is unaffected). Destroyable under Rule 24 by a die >= its power. Not playable while already held.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is a Block card.
The permanent is not already in the caster's holding.

effects.description: Number of d6 the placement point-buy rolls against Vitality.
Combat damage the holder takes from the defender's action: 0 for Attack/Block, otherwise the normal matrix damage.
A Rule 24 point-buy die destroys the permanent when it reaches the placement power.

skill_sanctuary.description: Permanent skill played with a Block card; point_buy_stat 'any' means the placement die is rolled against the caster's highest stat. While held (user ruling 2026-11-16: 'move around and prepare your hand in the next turns being invincible') the holder takes no combat and no effect damage as long as it only moves or rests — Move, Empty Move, Empty Posture, with no skill (a building's free skill excepted), no effect emission and no Rule 24 destroy emission. Any other action (Attack, Block, Posture, a Battle Trance option among them), a skill or an emission ends it: unprotected in that action, the permanent leaves the holding afterwards. Protection of the holder's permanents / tokens is not modelled. Destroyable under Rule 24 by a die >= its power.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is a Block card.
The permanent is not already in the caster's holding.

effects.description: Number of d6 the placement point-buy rolls against the caster's highest stat ('any').
True while the holder only moves or rests: Move / Empty Move / Empty Posture, no skill, no emission.
The permanent is removed after an action that does not keep it (Attack, Block, Posture, a skill, an emission).
A Rule 24 point-buy die destroys the permanent when it reaches the placement power.

skill_disruption_move.description: Instant riding on a Move card (also Empty Move / Empty Posture per the pc implementation) against an enemy target. Paper text implemented (user ruling 2026-11-16): the enemy cannot use Posture — a declared Posture is negated (card and riding instants back to their hand) — and any Empty Posture is always played as Empty Move: either way the target plays an Empty Move that goes nowhere and emits nothing, so a non-instant effect it was emitting is voided and a cast in progress is interrupted (Rule 19); instants still go out. Judged by whether it did its job (negated a Posture or stopped an emission); otherwise it returns to hand.

The target is an enemy unit.

effects.description: Posture and Empty Posture become Empty Move; anything else unchanged.
Whether the target may still emit a non-instant effect after the disruption (an Empty Move emits nothing).
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.

skill_dodge.description: Instant riding on a Move card (or an empty action). One point comes off the total combat damage the caster takes this action: one hit is reduced by 1, not one per attacker. Effect damage is not reduced. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when the caster took no combat damage.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action is Move (or an empty action, which carries Move skills).

effects.description: 1 when any combat damage would land on the caster this action, else 0 (never more than 1 in total).
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.

skill_bluff.description: Instant riding on a Move card (or an empty action) against an enemy in contact. The target's declared action is replaced by Empty Posture (a Battle Trance collapses too); the target then resolves as EP against everyone. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when the target was already on EP or the replacement changed nothing.

The target is an enemy in contact.

effects.description: The target's action is forced to Empty Posture.
Combat damage the target can still deal to the caster: the EP row of the matrix (always 0).
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.

skill_intimidation.description: Instant riding on a Posture card (or an empty action). Every enemy in contact with the caster who declared Attack has it replaced by Empty Posture for this action (no target needed; class stances such as Reaver may lift the EP back afterwards). The paper 'until end of round' lock is applied per action in the pc game. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when no adjacent enemy was Attacking.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action is Posture (or an empty action, which carries Posture skills).

effects.description: For each enemy in contact: Attack becomes Empty Posture, anything else unchanged.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.

validation.description: point_buy_stat is null, 'any' or one of the four stats.

skill_battle_trance.description: Trance instant: rides on ANY real action card ('*' in the pc game, Posture on paper) and lets the caster play a second action card this turn. Per adjacent enemy the resolver picks the option (first, second, or both) that benefits the trance actor most (dealt minus taken); each Attack option hits at most one enemy, the declared target chooses first; with nobody adjacent both options are played. A countered trance collapses to its first card. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when the second option never improved the maths.

prerequisites.description: The caster plays a real action card (A/B/M/P), not an empty action.
Two action codes are queued (the trance pair), both battle codes.

effects.description: The caster resolves with two action options this turn.
Against one defender the trance scores the better of its two options' matrix damage.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.

validation.description: Stays a Posture-family / any-action trance skill.
point_buy_stat is null, 'any' or one of the four stats.

skill_counter_spell.description: Instant riding on a Posture card (or an empty action) against an enemy in contact (the right-clicked one; otherwise the adjacent damaging caster it saves the most against). The target loses every non-permanent skill played this action (a trance collapses to its first card). Then the caster emits one element of the target's cast: the caster's stat for that element is subtracted from the target's stat for EVERY instance of that element in the cast before Rule 21 — effective stat per instance = max0(target_stat - caster_stat). Two counters aimed at each other resolve in actor order. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when nothing was stripped or saved.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action is Posture (or an empty action, which carries Posture skills).
The target is an enemy in contact.

effects.description: Amount taken off the target's stat for each instance of the countered element: the caster's own stat behind that element.
The target's effective stat for the countered element after the penalty: max0(target_stat - caster_stat).
The emitted element must be one of the elements of the target's cast.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.
